meta.title: Medi-Bela: medicine reminders and family care for Bangladesh
meta.description: Medi-Bela turns a pharmacist-checked prescription into daily medicine reminders and alerts your family when a dose is missed. Join the waitlist and play the daily quiz.
meta.aboutDescription: Who builds Medi-Bela, our mission and what we work for.

hero.lede: Medi-Bela turns a pharmacist-checked prescription into daily medicine reminders, and tells your family when a dose is missed. Made for Bangladesh, in Bangla and English.
hero.note: Sign up with your mobile number · one try a day · top 3 win an attractive prize

about.statement: A medicine-care app for Bangladesh, built around the people who look after you.
about.p1: Medi-Bela helps patients take their medicines on time and helps families care for each other. A pharmacist checks every prescription before it becomes a reminder, so your schedule is prepared by a person, not guessed by a machine.
about.p2: It speaks Bangla and English, keeps working without internet and catches up when you are back online.

roles.what: Get reminders, mark doses taken, keep readings and health records in one place.
A caregiver can help manage medicines and is alerted when a dose is missed.
Check each prescription and prepare the schedule, or send it back with a note.

features.title: Everything a daily medicine routine needs. Nothing it doesn't.
features.leadTitle: Reminders that ring like an alarm.
features.leadText: Each dose rings with an alarm tone, even when the app is closed. Tap Taken or Later right on the reminder.
leadSteps: Rings at the dose time, then rings again if you don't respond
The lock screen shows only the time and how many medicines, never their names
Your family is alerted if the dose is still missed

items.title: Prescription to schedule
items.text: Upload a photo of your prescription. A pharmacist checks it and prepares your medicines. You confirm, adjust times or meal timing, and the reminders are made for you.

items.title: Family care
items.text: One family member can be the caregiver: help upload prescriptions, manage medicines and see dose status. Anyone can choose Hide from family.

items.title: Medicine box
items.text: Tell the app how many you have. It counts down with every dose taken and lets you know when you are running low.

items.title: Readings and records
items.text: Log blood sugar, blood pressure, weight and more. Keep doctor visits, test reminders and report photos together, and make a 30-day summary PDF for your doctor.

items.title: A careful AI assistant
items.text: Ask general health questions in Bangla or English. It never diagnoses, never picks a medicine for you and never tells you a dose.

items.title: Easy for everyone
items.text: Bangla first, English one tap away. Larger text, an Easy mode with one big Taken button and quick calls to your caregiver or 999, and a dark mode.

how.title: From a paper prescription to peace of mind, in three steps.

steps.title: Upload your prescription
steps.text: Take a photo of the prescription in the app and send it.

steps.title: A pharmacist checks it
steps.text: A pharmacist prepares your medicine list and timings. You confirm it, or ask for an edit.

steps.title: Stay on track, together
steps.text: Medi-Bela reminds you at every dose and keeps your caregiver in the loop.

screens.title: Calm, clear and easy to read.

items.a: A medicine-reminder and family-care app for Bangladesh. You upload a prescription, a pharmacist checks it, and the app reminds you at every dose. Your family is alerted if a dose is missed.

items.q: When can I download the app?
items.a: We are preparing the Android launch. Join the waitlist and we will contact you on your mobile number when it is ready.

items.q: Why do I need an account to play?
items.a: Only the quiz and the waitlist need an account (your mobile number and a password), so each person plays once a day and winners can be contacted. Your number is never shown publicly.
Yes. Playing is free. You get one try every day until the app launches.
Each correct answer gives between 500 and 975 points: the faster you answer, the more you get. Wrong answers and timeouts give 0.

items.q: Does this website collect medical information?
items.a: No. We only keep your name and mobile number, your nickname, your quiz answers and your consent choices. Please never send symptoms or medical details through the contact form.

items.q: Does the AI assistant replace my doctor?
items.a: No. It gives general health information only. It never diagnoses, never suggests a medicine for your problem and never gives a dose. Always talk to your doctor.
